findings.title: 19 tap/click target(s) smaller than 24×24 px on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Small targets take longer to acquire and cause mis-taps, especially on touch.
findings.fix: Make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 px for touch); add padding rather than enlarging icons.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: JavaScript error
findings.detail: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'x')
findings.fix: Fix the error; wrap risky operations so failures show recoverable UI rather than breaking silently.

findings.title: Dead click on “Buy now”
findings.detail: 4 clicks produced no visible change (no DOM update, no navigation) within 1 s. The element is interactive, so feedback is missing or delayed.
findings.fix: Provide immediate visual feedback (active state, spinner, toast) for every action.

findings.title: 36% of all clicks were dead clicks
findings.detail: 4 of 11 clicks produced no response. Users are repeatedly misreading what is clickable.
findings.fix: Audit affordances: clickable things should look clickable, and non-clickable things should not.
findings.key: feedback|#% of all clicks were dead clicks|

findings.title: Field friction: “email”
findings.detail: Focused 3×, 8 deletions vs 3 keystrokes, 0.1 s total. Users are struggling with the expected format or meaning.
findings.fix: Show the expected format up front (example/mask), validate inline as the user types, and accept flexible input.

findings.title: Form started but not submitted (2 fields touched)
findings.detail: On /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html the user interacted with 2 fields but never submitted.
findings.fix: Reduce the number of fields, show progress, save drafts, and make the primary action obvious.
findings.key: forms|Form started but not submitted (# fields touched)|/Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html

findings.principle: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status · Affordance
findings.title: Rage clicks on “Buy now”
findings.detail: User clicked 3 times in rapid succession on an interactive element (1 burst). This is a strong indicator the user expected something to happen and it didn't — or it was too slow.
findings.fix: Make the response immediate: show a pressed/loading state within 100 ms, disable while processing, and confirm completion.

findings.principle: Hick's Law · Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall
findings.title: Hesitation over “Explode”
findings.detail: User hovered for 2.8 s without acting — a sign of uncertainty about what this control does or what will happen.
findings.fix: Clarify the label, add helper text or a preview of the outcome; reduce ambiguity between similar options.

findings.title: Navigation with 12 items on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Decision time grows with the number of choices. Long flat menus are hard to scan and remember.
findings.fix: Group into 5–9 top-level categories; move secondary items into sub-menus or a footer.

findings.title: 13 links with href="#" or javascript: on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
